implications: India's role as a mediator may raise its diplomatic profile in the Russia-Ukraine conflict.
A successful truce could ease risks to energy supplies and shipping routes that India depends on.

reports.headline: India to Turkiye, can new proposals to broker Russia-Ukraine truce succeed?
reports.summary: India, Turkiye, Egypt and the US have put forward proposals for ceasefires in bid to protect global energy and shipping.

items.headline: Kremlin aide visits China amid speculation about potential Xi-Putin-Trump meeting
items.why: A possible Xi-Putin-Trump summit at next month's APEC meeting could reshape relations among three powers central to India's security, energy and trade ties.
implications: Closer US-Russia-China engagement may require India to reassess its diplomatic balancing among these powers.
Any shift in US policy toward Russia could affect conditions around India's crude oil purchases from Russia.
New Delhi is likely to watch the APEC meeting closely for signals affecting its regional security interests.

reports.headline: Kremlin aide visits China amid speculation about potential Xi-Putin-Trump meeting
reports.summary: An aide to Russia’s president arrived in China on Thursday for a visit that will be closely watched for signs of preparation for a possible trilateral summit with the US during the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation leaders’ meeting next month.

items.headline: From competing for food to a gold medal: the stories behind India’s Asian Games winners
items.why: India's 85-medal Asian Games haul, with athletes who trained on limited money, is a national sports story that may shape support debates.
implications: Medal success by under-resourced athletes may increase pressure for more public funding and facilities for non-cricket sports.
Strong results could raise youth interest in sports beyond cricket.

reports.headline: From competing for food to a gold medal: the stories behind India’s Asian Games winners
reports.summary: The country’s 85-medal haul included athletes who trained with limited money and borrowed equipment. Plus, the Mumbai performer turning everyday absurdities into comedy
reports.lede: In a country where cricket eclipses every other sport, the recently concluded Asian Games offered a much-needed reminder of India’s breadth of sporting talent. In this edition of the games, in Japan, India won 85 medals : 21 golds, 27 silver and 37 bronze medals. I admit I did not know many of the players competing, or even some of the sports they play before putting this piece together. Learning

items.headline: India's 'cockroach' protesters are back - this time asking poll chief to resign
items.why: Large Mumbai protest demanding the resignation of India's election commissioner puts pressure on an Indian electoral institution.
implications: Public pressure on the poll body could fuel debate over electoral oversight and institutional credibility.
Continued large protests may affect public order and political activity in Mumbai.

reports.headline: India's 'cockroach' protesters are back - this time asking poll chief to resign
reports.summary: Thousands of people have turned up at a protest in Mumbai called by the Cockroach Janta Party.

reports.headline: India’s Cockroach movement launches new protests over changes to voter roll
reports.summary: Thousands gather in Mumbai with heavy police presence as concerns mount that millions will be denied voting rights
reports.lede: India’s youth-led Cockroach movement kicked off more nationwide protests on Friday as thousands of people gathered in Mumbai, amid mounting concerns that millions of citizens are being unfairly stripped of their vote.

reports.headline: India’s supreme court demands answers over changes to voter roll
reports.summary: Modi government, election body and its head issued notices after removal of millions from lists prompts mass protests
reports.lede: India’s supreme court has demanded accountability from the government and the election body over a controversial exercise that has led to the deletion of tens of millions of voters from the electoral roll and prompted mass protests.

items.headline: Indian police accused of sexually harassing journalists at protest
items.why: Allegations against police over treatment of journalists at a protest over voter-roll changes concern press freedom and electoral governance in India.
implications: The allegations could draw scrutiny of police conduct and press freedom, and may prompt official inquiries or court action.
Protests over voter-roll changes may keep pressure on the election authority and fuel political debate.

reports.headline: Indian police accused of sexually harassing journalists at protest
reports.summary: The allegations were made after police detained dozens of protesters demanding the resignation of the election chief over changes to voter rolls.

reports.headline: India's 'Cockroach' protests intensify as police probe harassment claims
reports.summary: Delhi police say three female journalists have made sexual harassment allegations against officers during protests against India's electoral commission.
